analysis.selection: control_account_pool.choose ranks login refusal, utilization, active runs, last use and account id, in that order. Fresh fixture accounts have no windows or uses. Pooled reservations record reserved_seq; retired records remain visible to _uses. Thus healthy completions alone do not explain starving the unused claude-b account in the original fixture.
analysis.line: Line.run settles ended runs, then offers assigned units in sorted order. Line.limited retries a named account-login refusal through another_account, which rechecks login and excludes accounts still logged out.
analysis.loop: FactoryLoop.run only processes queued wakes and writes the loop_pass observation after the line finishes. The original journey could stop after 30 seconds with unchanged dispatch states and no holding record, without proving the receiver refusal or retry.
analysis.original_failure: The quiet exit is a timing-dependent failure path in the code. The precise trigger of the reported 16-worker gate failure remains unconfirmed: this session cannot run the installed-host fixture far enough to reproduce it.
